expressions.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Ordinance, 1974
expressions.title_basis: p1 (Gazette of Pakistan Extra., Sept. 30, 1974, p.377) prints 'ORDINANCE No. XV OF 1974 AN ORDINANCE to repeal certain laws relating to evacuee property and rehabilitation of displaced persons', the preamble and ss.1-2; p2 (p.378) ss.2(3)-4; p3 (p.379) the end of s.4 and the signatures ending 'MOHAMMAD AFZAL CHEEMA, Secretary' (block 1566523). Ordinance No. XVI of 1974 (the Evacuee Trust Property (Management and Disposal) Ordinance, 1974) that follows on p3 is held released as document 6997 and is set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split').
